title: GUARDIAN://PASSPORT/v1
description: Live signed passport. Templates are not instances of this schema: they omit issued_at, expires_at, and signature. Those three fields are filled at mint.

x-guardian-canonicalization.rule: UTF-8 JSON with sorted keys and no insignificant whitespace. Signature key stripped before hashing.
x-guardian-canonicalization.profile: RFC 8785 JCS-compatible for objects, arrays, strings, integers, booleans, and null.

x-guardian-ttl.note: issued_at and expires_at are mint-time Unix integers. They are not schema constants. A template that ships 1741295320 is invalid.

x-guardian-algorithm.superseded: Curve25519 names X25519 key-agreement, not signing. Guardian matches Ed25519 exactly.

key_type.description: Signing algorithm on the signed payload. Not Curve25519.

issued_at.description: Unix seconds at mint (now). Must not be copied from a template.

expires_at.description: Unix seconds; issued_at + 3600. Authoritative TTL bound.

signature.description: Stripped before canonicalization. Not part of the signed bytes.

value.description: Standard Base64 of the 64-byte Ed25519 signature.
